verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a developer-facing payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a Checkout.com command-line tool: the docs cover payments, issuing and multi-currency accounts, and the community items concern a data breach. The llms.txt probe is an AI-readable documentation file, an adjacent feature that does not count as a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
